lora_profiles.label: LoRa profile
lora_profiles.help: Load modem settings, adjust them below, then Apply. Tune the VFO to the network frequency separately.
lora_profiles.reticulum_help: Example SF8/BW125 settings for an SX126x RNode. Match the spreading factor, bandwidth, coding rate and preamble to your network.
lora_profiles.lorawan_help: Receives one channel and data rate at a time. Downlink profiles invert IQ. Explicit headers announce coding rate and CRC presence.

background.description: Keep VFOs, decoders, and recordings running after pressing Stop or closing this tab. Unattended VFOs stay at their last frequency. The next user to join takes control. Uncheck this before pressing Stop to end the observation.
background.detach_stream: Detach and keep receiving in background
background.adopt_description: Adopt the running observation and replace your current VFOs.
background.join_description: Joining an unattended observation gives you control of its running VFOs and decoders. Frequencies stay fixed until you change them.

toolbar.fft_overflow: FFT update rate overflow — incoming updates are being throttled

sdr.title: SDR
sdr.sdr_hint: Select a receiver, or SigMF Playback to replay a saved IQ recording.
sdr.playback_recording_hint: Select a saved IQ recording to replay through the waterfall and decoders.
sdr.sdr_required: Select an SDR before starting stream
sdr.gain_hint: Sets receiver amplification. Increase for weak signals; reduce if strong signals overload the receiver.
sdr.gain_element_hint: Adjusts the {{name}} receiver stage to balance sensitivity and overload.
sdr.attenuation_hint: Adds input attenuation. Higher settings reduce signal strength to help prevent overload.
sdr.rf_gain_reduction_hint: Selects the LNA attenuation state. Higher states reduce RF gain; attenuation varies with frequency.
sdr.sample_rate_hint: Sets how much spectrum is sampled. Higher rates use more CPU and data bandwidth.
sdr.if_bandwidth_hint: Sets the receiver filter for all VFOs. Auto selects the smallest compatible filter covering the sample rate, or the widest available filter. Wider filters can admit signals that alias into the sampled span.
sdr.if_bandwidth_limited: covers part of the sampled span
sdr.if_bandwidth_tasks_outside: The IF filter does not cover all task frequencies. Widen it or change the center frequency.
sdr.sample_rate_required: Select sample rate before starting stream
sdr.antenna_hint: Select the physical receive input connected to your antenna.
sdr.clock_source_hint: Select the frequency reference. Use the internal clock unless an external reference is connected.
sdr.time_source_hint: Select the source used to synchronize hardware timestamps, such as internal timing, GPS, or external PPS.
sdr.bias_t_confirm_warning: Enabling Bias-T supplies DC voltage through the antenna cable. This voltage can damage antennas, amplifiers, or other connected devices that do not support it. Only continue if all equipment in the signal path is compatible with the SDR's Bias-T voltage.
sdr.refresh_params: Reload SDR parameters (uses cached capabilities when available)

vfo.title: VFO Controls
vfo.locked_by_tracking: This VFO is locked by the satellite tracking process
vfo.parakeet_language_info: Parakeet sends audio to the configured service and detects supported languages automatically. The source language selection is used only for translation.
vfo.external_translation_info: Translation uses Google Translate API (configured in Settings).
vfo.audio_demodulation_help: How to extract audio from the RF signal
vfo.decoder_active_info: Audio demodulation is automatically handled by the decoder

recording.title: IQ Recording
recording.centeredBandwidthHelp: Records the centered portion of the SDR spectrum. Center the signal before recording.
recording.storageFormatFloatHelp: Lossless, full-precision IQ. Uses twice the disk space of ci16_le.
recording.storageFormatInt16Help: 50% smaller. Lossy only if exceptionally strong samples clip.

playback.title: IQ Playback
playback.no_recordings: No recordings available. Record some IQ data first!
